configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: The reconstruction + full test suite against the portable shim backends (FileDump/Memory graphics, Null audio/platform). No SDL2/Vulkan needed.

configurePresets.name: vulkan-sdl
configurePresets.description: Builds the Vulkan graphics backend + SDL2 audio/window/input backend, pulling deps via the vcpkg manifest. Movie DLL stubbed (videos skipped); copy-protection skipped. Set VCPKG_ROOT (or ~/vcpkg) before configuring.

configurePresets.name: vulkan-sdl-system
configurePresets.displayName: Real backends: Vulkan + SDL2 (system packages, no vcpkg)
configurePresets.description: Same as vulkan-sdl but resolves SDL2/Vulkan via system find_package instead of vcpkg — for environments where the dev packages are already installed.
